name: chatgpt_conversation
source_description: User-assistant exchange about an AI project with technical terms
screen_text: Lead off, here's the chat. User wrote: I'm fine-tuning a LoRA on top of Llama3 for legal docs. Should I host inference on vLLM or on a managed service? Assistant replied: for a LoRA over Llama3, vLLM gives you better throughput on a single A100, and it plays nicely with LangGraph for the agentic loop. If you need streaming with Pinecone retrieval, that also works. User wrote back: ok let's start with vLLM. Can you also wire up LangSmith for tracing?
